description: KaliCart Global searches participating WooCommerce merchants through one consented, policy-scoped catalog. It shows match evidence and snapshot provenance, then verifies a selected product live through a server-side Bridge read that preserves the OpenAI scope. It is read-only and does not place orders or process payments.

defaultPrompt: Find products across participating stores, show match evidence, and verify the best result live within the OpenAI policy scope.
Find skin creams in the consented catalog, show match evidence, and verify one live within the same policy scope.
List the merchants currently available through KaliCart and compare their indexed product counts.
